summary.intent: Improve test coverage for PR FSM1/cipher-box#424, specifically targeting the 42 lines at 0% patch coverage flagged by Codecov in auth.rs and fuse/mod.rs.
summary.outcome: Added 8 passing unit tests for `apply_versioning()` in crates/fuse/src/helpers.rs. The 39 lines in auth.rs and 3 lines in fuse/mod.rs remain uncovered as they are untestable without full runtime mocking.

repo: auth.rs commands (load_vault_settings, complete_auth_setup) are pure glue code: API calls, IPNS resolve, IPFS fetch, ECIES decrypt, Tauri state — not unit-testable without full runtime mocking.
fuse/mod.rs mount_filesystem() lines require a live FUSE mount to test.
apply_versioning() in crates/fuse/src/helpers.rs is pure logic with no I/O, extracted from duplicated platform code but had zero tests prior to this session.
Codecov patch coverage was 0% for 42 lines across auth.rs (39) and fuse/mod.rs (3).

code.finding: apply_versioning() is pure business logic covering cooldown and pruning — 8 test cases added covering edge cases with no mocking needed.
39 uncoverable lines — integration-only code dependent on Tauri runtime, IPFS, IPNS, and ECIES stack.

workflow: Codecov patch coverage reports are useful for scoping coverage work, but integration glue code will always show 0% — important to distinguish before investing effort.
Worktree cleanup (removing stale agent-* worktrees and their branches) was part of the PR workflow.
pnpm lint:fix was run before the coverage discussion, suggesting a pre-PR lint pass is part of the normal workflow.

friction: Codecov flagged 42 lines at 0% patch coverage, but 39 of those (auth.rs) are structurally untestable at the unit level — creating pressure to add tests where none are practically feasible.
open_items: auth.rs and fuse/mod.rs integration paths remain at 0% patch coverage and would require integration test infrastructure (Tauri runtime, live FUSE mount) to address — intentionally deferred.
The new apply_versioning() tests improve logic coverage but won't meaningfully move the Codecov patch % for this PR since the flagged lines are in different files.
